pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Stellate and angular dark regions with sharp pixel-level gradients at the edges. Patches on the cervical region exhibit larger spatial area, while those on the posterior flank are more fragmented and reduced in scale.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological mesh formed by light-colored pelage. Junction nodes are distinctly visible where three or more patches meet. The thickness of these pathways is relatively uniform throughout the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct light-toned, pendulous protrusion on the ventral abdominal/inguinal profile.
